name: Collecting Memories
summary: In Stormwind City, Wilder Thistlenettle asks you to remember the miners lost beneath Moonbrook. He wants their Miners' Union Cards returned to their grieving families.

sections.title: A Tragic Collapse
sections.body: Before the Defias Brotherhood brought lawlessness to Moonbrook, Westfall's mines supported many working-class families. Wilder Thistlenettle survived when a cave-in buried one wing of the tunnels. Many friends and fellow miners died underground, beyond the reach of rescue. Their families in Stormwind never learned for certain what became of them.

sections.title: Restless Remains
sections.body: The miners killed in the collapse now wander the tunnels outside the main iron works as undead. You search those haunted passages for their Miners' Union Cards and face the remains of the men Wilder worked beside. Bring the cards back to Stormwind so their families can learn what happened and Wilder can honor his fallen companions.

faq.answer: Wilder Thistlenettle is a dwarven miner in Stormwind City. He survived a cave-in beneath Westfall that killed his close coworkers. Now he seeks to bring confirmation and peace to their families.

faq.q: What happened to the miners in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: A cave-in trapped and killed a crew of miners in a wing of the Moonbrook dig sites. Their bodies and spirits now haunt the abandoned passages as undead.

faq.q: Why does Wilder want their Miners' Union Cards?
aliases: what are the union cards for
faq.answer: The Miners' Union Cards identify the workers who died in the collapse. Their bodies were never recovered, so Wilder wants to return the cards and let their families in Stormwind learn what happened.

faq.q: Where are the union cards found?
aliases: where do i find the cards
faq.answer: The cards lie in the haunted outer tunnels beneath Moonbrook, in the corridors before the secured entrance to the Deadmines proper.

faq.q: Did the Defias Brotherhood cause the cave-in?
aliases: did defias cause the cave in
faq.answer: Wilder remembers a terrible mining accident and cave-in. The Defias Brotherhood rules the deep passages now, but the collapse appears to have been an industrial accident that trapped the miners.

faq.q: Are the miners considered part of the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: No. They were ordinary union laborers when the cave-in struck. Their undead remains wander the cavern edges, apart from Edwin VanCleef's organized Defias forces deeper inside.

angles.text: As a miner, you know the dread of a shaft collapse. Recovering the lost union cards gives that fear a solemn weight.
As a dwarf, you know the bonds forged underground and the honor owed to fallen kin. Wilder Thistlenettle's plea reaches close to home.
As an Alliance member, you can help the grieving families of Westfall workers. They endure hard times within Stormwind's walls.
